success_criterion: SUCCESS iff: keeper in green zone before red deadline; ball blocked on keeper front face; ball does NOT enter the goal; grippers open. Every episode also requires an on-frame shot (ball target inside the goal mouth), including after Opt-1 bounce.
notes: Controller suite PASSED 20/20. Episode success = save (ball does not enter goal). Path validity separately asserts the shot would go through the goal frame if unsaved.
